tools.name: apply_auto_clustering
tools.title: Apply a proposed clustering
tools.description: Apply the grouping a completed start_auto_clustering job proposed: creates the clusters it named and moves the tracked queries into them, as the job's mode said. Cluster names are lower-cased like create_clusters, and a proposed name that matches an existing cluster reuses it instead of creating a second one. Show the proposal (get_job) to the user first. Pass a fresh requestId and reuse it if you retry, so a retry never applies twice.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key, 8-255 printable characters. Reuse it only to retry this same call.

successful.description: Tracked queries written, each with the cluster ids it ended up with - the resulting state, not the delta.

failed.description: Always present, empty list included: read it rather than inferring success from the status code.

clusters.description: Every cluster the assignments referred to, and whether this call created it.

skippedClusters.description: Proposed names the store cannot hold. A tracked query whose proposed cluster was skipped ends up with fewer clusters than the proposal showed.

unassigned.description: Tracked queries the job produced no assignment for. Nothing was written for them and they keep the clusters they already had, under every merge mode.

outputSchema.description: Per-tracked-query results of applying a clustering job

Tracked queries are added afterwards with create_tracked_queries. Before calling it, propose everything to the user at once: brand names from suggest_brand_names, and competitors you suggest with their websites (no tool finds competitors; suggest_brand_names finds the names each one goes by). After the first checks, list_untracked_competitors shows other brands the answers name. Pass a fresh requestId and reuse it if you retry, so a retry never creates a second project.

tools.name: create_tracked_queries
tools.title: Create tracked queries
tools.description: Start tracking queries: every combination of queryTexts x engines x countries (at most 100) becomes a tracked query, checked now and then on checkFrequency with nPasses passes, each check spending budget. Combinations the project already tracks, repeated ones and Google AI Mode in unsupported countries are skipped and reported. Requires a confirmationToken: call preview_operation with tool "create_tracked_queries" and these arguments first, show the returned plan (what is created, what it costs) to the user, and call this tool only after the user explicitly agrees. Pass a fresh requestId and reuse it if you retry.

nPasses.description: Answers captured per check; more than 1 only for AI engines. Each pass costs one check.

locale.description: Optional two-letter language the engines should answer in

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key, 8-255 printable characters. Reuse it only to retry this same call.

successful.description: Tracked queries created by this call, one entry per query text, engine and country combination.

failed.description: Always present, empty list included: read it rather than inferring success from the status code.

tools.name: discover_brands

Poll get_job for the result, review it with the user, then track the chosen ones with create_tracked_queries. Requires an active subscription.

tools.name: get_available_filters
tools.title: Get available project filters
tools.description: Discover the engines, countries, keyword clusters and competitors configured on a project so subsequent metric tools can be called with valid filter values. Engines and countries are returned as {code, label} (e.g. {"code":"chatgpt","label":"ChatGPT"}, {"code":"US","label":"United States"}); clusters and competitors as {id, name}. Always pass the "code"/"id" (never the label/name) to the other tools' engines / countries / queryClusterIds / competitorId(s) parameters. Call this before filtering.

tools.name: get_cited_sources
tools.title: Cited domains and pages
tools.description: The domains (groupBy=domain) or pages (groupBy=page) most cited across a project's AI answers in a date window — the sources the answer engines drew on. Per source: how many times it was cited, how many distinct answers and tracked queries it appeared in, and its average rank within the citation lists. The list is UNFILTERED by ownership: it includes the brand's, competitors' and third-party sources. Only AI answer engines (chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode) produce citations. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "which websites and pages does the AI cite or quote for me versus competitors".

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode (only AI engines carry citations)

groupBy.description: "domain" to roll up by host, "page" to roll up by exact URL

tools.name: get_cluster_breakdown
tools.title: Rank tracking by keyword cluster
tools.description: Rank-tracking metrics broken down per keyword cluster for a project over a date window: one row per cluster with its positions, share of voice and sentiment. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "which keyword clusters are strongest or weakest" or "how does my niche compare to my generic queries".

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

mentionRate.description: Percentage 0-100 of AI checks (one per tracked query x engine x UTC day) in the period that mentioned the brand, each check counted as the share of its passes that did; higher is better.

serpRate.description: Percentage 0-100 of traditional-search checks (one per tracked query x engine x UTC day) in the period in which the brand ranked; higher is better.

shareOfVoice.description: 0-100 percentage share of weighted AI mentions vs all tracked brands; higher is better.

tools.name: get_competitor_cooccurrence
tools.title: Competitor co-occurrence (head-to-head)
tools.description: For the AI answers where the brand and a competitor are BOTH mentioned, compares who is named higher. One row per tracked competitor: how many answers they co-appear in, how often the brand out-ranks / loses to / ties them (by best mention position), the win rate, the average positions, and one representative shared query. Optionally focus a single competitor via competitorId. Tracked competitors only. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "who wins when we both appear", "do I outrank competitor X", "who is mentioned first".

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode (SERP/Shopping have no AI text mentions)

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

competitorId.description: optional competitor UUID to focus on a single rival; competitor UUIDs are listed by get_available_filters (competitors[].id)

winRate.description: Percentage 0-100 of shared answers where the brand outranks the competitor; higher is better.

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Get a background job
tools.description: The status and, once completed, the result of a background job started by discover_brands, suggest_brand_names, discover_keywords, discover_prompts or start_auto_clustering. Poll it every few seconds until status is "completed" or "failed"; do not start the job again while it is pending or running.

type.description: What the job produces, and therefore the shape of `result`

status.description: A job in `pending`, `running` or `awaiting_retry` is still in flight; `completed` and `failed` are terminal.

result.description: The job output, shaped by `type`. Null while the job is still in flight and for a job that failed: it means the result is not known, never that the job produced nothing.

outputSchema.description: An asynchronous job and, once it has completed, its result

tools.name: get_mencoro_guide
tools.title: Mencoro guide
tools.description: Answer questions about Mencoro itself from its public guide: what it tracks, how a check runs, what counts as a mention, how Coverage, Favorability, share of voice, positions and stability are calculated, how checks, plans and frequencies work, reliability and limits, how to use this MCP server (permissions, confirmations), how to analyse results and find what to improve, pairing with Ahrefs, Semrush, Search Console or Google Analytics MCP servers, and the REST API. Call it without a topic for the index, then with the topic that answers the question. No account data; works without signing in.

topic.description: The topic to read; omit it, or pass "index", for the list of topics.
The topic answered, or "index" for the list of topics

source.description: The public page this topic is written from

topics.description: Every topic, on the index only; empty otherwise

tools.name: get_mention_mix
tools.title: AI mention mix (type/tone/qualifier)
tools.description: The project brand's own AI text-mention counts over a date window grouped by type, tone and qualifier; competitors (tracked or untracked) and unrelated brands are excluded. Counts are raw per-pass rows and leave out cited links, so they show mention composition, not the exact share-of-voice inputs (share of voice averages each check over its passes and also weights links). Use to understand mention composition. For the positive/neutral/negative sentiment split use get_sentiment_breakdown; to read the actual mention texts use get_mention_samples. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "am I recommended or just listed" or "break my mentions down by type".

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

For the aggregate sentiment split use get_sentiment_breakdown; for the brand's own mention counts by type, tone and qualifier use get_mention_mix. Filterable by engine, sentiment, mention type and competitor. Dates must fall within the data retention window. limit is 1-50 (default 20). Answers questions like "show or export the actual AI mention texts" for a query.

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

Call this first when a request is vague, non-technical, phrased in another language, or uses wording that does not match a tool name. Static reference; no project data.

serpRate.description: Percentage 0-100 of the bucket's SERP checks (one per query, engine and day) in which this entity appeared in the results; higher is better. 0 means checked and absent; null means no SERP check in the bucket.

tools.name: get_tracking_coverage
tools.title: Tracking coverage & staleness
tools.description: Coverage summary for a project's tracked queries: counts of total, active, paused, never-checked, and overdue (past their check-frequency interval) queries, plus a sample of the most-overdue ones. Answers "what is stale / not being tracked" in one call. Never-checked and overdue are scoped to active queries. This is a current-state snapshot and takes no date window. Answers questions like "what is stale or not being monitored", "which queries are overdue, paused, or never checked", "how fresh is my data".

tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Get plan and usage
tools.description: An organization's subscription, how many tracked queries it has, and how many checks they are projected to run per month. Plan entitlements (tracked-query and check limits) are included for owners only, as in the web app; for other members "entitlements" is null. Use it before creating tracked queries or raising check frequency, to stay within the plan.

subscription.description: The current subscription contract of an organization

status.description: Contract state. "none" when the organization has never held a subscription.

tierCode.description: Public tier identifier derived from the check budget.

billingCycleAnchor.description: Instant the billing cycle is anchored to.

checkBudget.description: Checks the current cycle grants. Null when there is no subscription, never a stand-in for zero.

checksConsumed.description: Checks consumed so far in the current cycle. Null when there is no subscription; zero means none consumed yet.

checksAvailable.description: Checks still available in the current cycle. Null when there is no subscription; zero means the budget is exhausted.

nextResetAt.description: When the check budget resets next.

cancelledAt.description: When the subscription was terminally cancelled. Null while it has not been.

scheduledToCancelAt.description: When a scheduled cancellation takes effect, while the subscription is still running. Null when none is scheduled.

gracePeriodEndsAt.description: When paid access ends after a cancellation. Null when the subscription is not cancelled.

deactivationReason.description: Why the subscription is currently inactive. Null for an active subscription, and meaningless once "cancelledAt" is set - the cancellation supersedes it.

isEntitled.description: Whether the organization may use paid features right now: active, or cancelled but still inside its paid grace window.

entitlements.description: Null unless the caller owns the organization.

anyOf.description: What an organization's plan allows and what it has consumed

status.description: "none" when the organization has never had a subscription contract.

checkBudget.description: Checks the current cycle allows. Null when there is no plan on file, which is not the same as a budget of zero.

checksConsumed.description: Checks consumed so far in the current cycle. Null when there is no plan on file.

checksAvailable.description: Checks left in the current cycle. Null when there is no plan on file.

billingCycleType.description: How often the allowance renews. Null when there is no plan on file.

billingCycleAnchor.description: Start of the current cycle. Null when there is no plan on file.

nextResetAt.description: When the check budget next resets. Null when there is no plan on file.

cancelledAt.description: When the subscription was terminally cancelled. Null while it has not been.

scheduledToCancelAt.description: When a scheduled cancellation takes effect, while the subscription is still running. Null when none is scheduled.

gracePeriodEndsAt.description: When paid access ends after a cancellation. Null when the subscription has not been cancelled.

trackedQueries.description: How many tracked queries an organization has configured

trackedQueryCount.description: Tracked queries across every project of the organization, archived projects included, counting active and paused queries alike. Never null; 0 means none are configured.

projectedMonthlyChecks.description: What an organization's current tracking configuration would consume in a month

tools.name: list_keyword_listings
tools.title: List keyword performance
tools.description: One row per tracked query text across all its engine and country variants, with its share of voice, positivity, mention, link, search and shopping positions over the date range (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Filter by engine, country, cluster, status, check frequency, passes or text; sort by any metric. The keyword-level view of a project.

items.description: One keyword of a project, its variants and its metrics over the requested window

keyword.description: The keyword as a human types it, picked from the variants for display.

keywordNormalized.description: The grouping key: the keyword lower-cased and unaccented. Unique within the project, and the stable way to match a row across pages.

variantCount.description: Tracked queries behind this row that the current filters selected.

variantIds.description: Ids of those tracked queries. Accepted by the single tracked-query operation.

engines.description: Distinct engines across the variants, not a single engine.

countries.description: Distinct ISO-3166 alpha-2 countries across the variants.

hasUnclusteredVariant.description: Whether at least one variant belongs to no cluster.

statusSummary.description: "mixed" when the variants disagree; otherwise the one status they share.

checkFrequencies.description: Distinct check frequencies across the variants.

avgShoppingPosition.description: Average position in shopping results over the window. 1-based, LOWER is better.

trendShopping.description: Signed improvement in avgShoppingPosition. Positive is better.

avgMentionPosition.description: Average position of the brand mention inside the AI answer. 1-based, LOWER is better.

trendMention.description: Signed improvement in avgMentionPosition. Positive is better.

avgLinkPosition.description: Average position of a cited link to the brand. 1-based, LOWER is better.

trendLink.description: Signed improvement in avgLinkPosition. Positive is better.

mentionPositionStability.description: Day-to-day spread of the mention position (a standard deviation): LOWER means steadier.

trendStability.description: Signed improvement in mentionPositionStability. Positive means steadier than the previous window.

positivityIndex.description: 0-100 weighted sentiment score of the mentions; HIGHER is better. Null when there were no mentions to score.

trendPositivity.description: Signed improvement in positivityIndex. Positive is better.

mentionRate.description: 0-100 share of AI captures in the window that mentioned the brand; HIGHER is better.

trendMentionRate.description: Signed improvement in mentionRate. Positive is better.

serpRate.description: 0-100 share of traditional-search captures in the window that ranked the brand; HIGHER is better.

trendSerpRate.description: Signed improvement in serpRate. Positive is better.

shareOfVoice.description: 0-100 share of the weighted AI mentions against every tracked brand; HIGHER is better.

trendShareOfVoice.description: Signed improvement in shareOfVoice. Positive is better.

sentimentPositive.description: Positive brand mentions counted in the window. Zero here really is zero.

sentimentNeutral.description: Neutral brand mentions counted in the window.

sentimentNegative.description: Negative brand mentions counted in the window.

avgMentionCount.description: Mentions per AI engine per day with a capture, over the window. Not a total: the window total is not part of this contract.

mentionTypeCounts.description: Mentions counted in the window by the role the mention plays in the answer. Totals, not averages.

totalVariantCount.description: Tracked queries behind all the matching rows

dataDirtySince.description: When the figures started being recomputed, if they are; null when they are current
